probe_title: BHT  MEDIUM PLATE Milestone 004 Engineering Probe
probe_notice: ENGINEERING PROBE  four isolated MEDIUM PLATE treatments. Initial render pass preserves source geometry and typography. Source excerpts remain locked. Graphic acceptance is component-specific.

quality_policy.acceptance: Provisional local measurement; not Amazon guidance or human legibility approval.
quality_policy.palette_auto_select: only if pixel-identical; otherwise keep RGB lossless

vertical_footprint.standing: Engineering budget only; Kindle pagination still requires Previewer and human review.

components.reason: Adjacency without cause/dependency must remain exactly positioned.
components.render_transform: Render-only repair 001: enlarge only the internal no-arrow explanatory text to 28px with readable line-height. Preserve the accepted 68% footprint, 1800px source width, SVG topology, plain lines, node positions, circle colors, wording, and relation-without-cause proposition. Explicitly allow bounded visual overflow solely so the enlarged internal no-arrow explanatory text may extend beyond the source root box while remaining within the renderer's 1.35x safety limit. The live figcaption remains outside the routed visual and is not included in the plate capture.
components.alt: Three unlabeled nodes form an open relation. One node connects by plain lines to two others; the outer nodes are not connected and no arrowheads claim direction, dependency, or cause.
components.description: Three nodes form an open relation. Plain lines connect one node to two others. The visual explicitly states that sequence and relation are shown without inventing cause.
required_labels: No arrowhead: sequence and relation are visible without inventing cause.

components.reason: Local first condition versus whole field depends on bounded position.
components.render_transform: Render-only repair 003: preserve the accepted 22px typography, 85% reader-facing footprint, 2111px reserve-compliant source width, grid, scope rectangle, strain marker, first-appearance label, and vertical placement; move only 'what remains outside' 20px farther right, from a 40px to a 20px right inset. Bounded visual overflow remains explicitly allowed.
components.alt: A bounded local field marks first appearance and immediate surroundings against what remains outside.
components.description: A field is divided by a quiet grid. A bounded scope and small strain marker identify a first local condition, while a separate label names what remains outside.

components.reason: Labels surrounding the present distinction lose meaning if they drift.
components.render_transform: Render-only repair 003: preserve the accepted 19px typography, 92% reader-facing footprint, 2284px reserve-compliant source width, surrounding node positions, wording, and field boundary; enlarge only the central present-distinction circle from the previous 74px treatment to 96px for clearer visual standing.
components.alt: Present distinction sits at the center of a field with six surrounding labels: arrived, surrounding, uncertain, pressure, consequence, and must remain visible.
components.description: A circular relation field holds present distinction at its center while six surrounding labels remain spatially attached to the larger field.

components.reason: Several nearby conditions must remain a field without becoming a complete field.
components.render_transform: Render-only repair 001: enlarge relation-plane center and node typography to 20px at a 92% reader-facing footprint while preserving the source center-circle physical dimensions, node positions, wording, field boundary, and provisional-field relation. Source capture width raised from 2000px to 2284px solely to satisfy the existing MFL 1.25x device-reserve policy at the 92% footprint.
components.alt: Visible field sits at the center with six surrounding conditions: adjacency, near-contradiction, unasked question, excluded condition, unopened relation, and uncertainty.
components.description: A circular relation field places visible field at the center with six nearby conditions arranged around it without claiming the field is complete.
